ambiguities.subject: /admin/team target role boundary
ambiguities.evidence: The /admin/team contract row is operator-only, while /team compatibility requires leader and operator at the same terminal route.
ambiguities.fail_closed_handling: Freeze two capabilities at one terminal: operator-only command-center content and leader/operator human-team content. U3B cannot implement the route until Architecture Review confirms this capability split.
ambiguities.recommended_resolution: Allow the /admin/team shell to leader and operator, enforce operator-only command-center capability separately, and preserve leader/operator human-team capability with session-tenant predicates.

ambiguities.subject: /platform-admin root query canonicalization
ambiguities.evidence: The contract names both query-driven root views and dedicated /superadmin/command and /superadmin/tenants terminal routes.
ambiguities.fail_closed_handling: Inventory freezes direct terminal candidates and forbids a redirect chain; U3B cannot ship until Architecture Review selects the canonical mapping.
ambiguities.recommended_resolution: Map view=command directly to /superadmin/command and tab=tenants directly to /superadmin/tenants; default maps to /superadmin.

ambiguities.subject: Exact compatibility query allowlist
ambiguities.evidence: Current helper forwards arbitrary query data; the contract requires an allowlist but only identifies minimum examples.
ambiguities.fail_closed_handling: Only source=bookmark and the explicitly consumed member UUID/root selector values below are candidates; all unknown keys are frozen as DROP. U3B cannot add another key without reviewed inventory remediation.
ambiguities.recommended_resolution: Consume tab=tenants and view=command as route selectors, preserve source=bookmark, preserve a validated member UUID only on team detail routes, and drop every other key.
